content.title: A Defence of the Catholic Faith concerning the Satisfaction of Christ, against Faustus Socinus (1617)
content.author: Hugo Grotius · translated with notes and an historical introduction by Frank Hugh Foster (Andover: Warren F. Draper, 1889)
content.note: The Dutch jurist's reply to Socinus, first printed at Leiden in 1617. It treats God in the atonement as ruler, and the law's penalty as relaxed but upheld by the example of Christ's punishment: later called the governmental theory. Foster's notes (pp. 257-259) summarise Socinus's De Jesu Christo Servatore. Public domain (published in the United States in 1889).
